definitions.peptide: SAGE target label=1, 0<=peptide_q<=.01, bracket modifications removed, I->L
definitions.quantification: positive finite LFQ feature intensity, gated by canonical target peptide IDs; summed over charge/modification features
definitions.CV: sample standard deviation / arithmetic mean over all 10 technical acquisitions, complete cases, no normalization or imputation
definitions.study_group: greedy set cover of pooled observed target peptide-protein graph, restricted to union of actually searched FASTAs; lexical gain ties
definitions.sample_group: lexically smallest member of the feature protein set, not new within-sample parsimony

limits: Reused reference lakes and existing de novo predictions; no new raw conversion or de novo model inference.
No independent FDR validation was performed in these 30 searches; reported q values are search-engine estimates.
Pooled evidence couples technical replicates; these runs do not establish out-of-cohort generalization.
The matched metagenome is a comparator, not a complete ground truth.
Study keys are defined for observed evidence-bearing proteins; searched proteins without observed peptides remain unassigned.
